coder: Claude Fable 5.1 (the agent that ran the study), coded from results/_audit_view_0_40.txt which lists every observation of the queried field before the question; not blind to layout
sampling: analyze.py --audit-export 40: wrong trap answers from the main gemini-3.1-flash-lite grid, stratified across layouts (L1 11, L2 11, L3 8 = all L3 wrong answers, L4 10), seeded

codes.stale_value: the answer equals an earlier observation of the same (record, field) that a later tool result had superseded
codes.reveal_not_executed: the agent skipped the scripted tool call that would have revealed the fresh value, so the fresh value never entered the context (an action-fidelity failure, not a stale read)
codes.ambiguous_stale_or_boundary: below-threshold question where the fresh quantity equals the threshold; the wrong answer fits both a stale read and a strict-inequality misreading
codes.arithmetic_or_count: the answer matches no observed value and looks derived
codes.distractor_record: the answer equals another record's value for the same field (none found as the sole explanation)
